title: feat(scenarios): export-gallery --check, the mechanical check a gallery PR must pass
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbTpKm2LSbAerqZvDtGXn2wb)_

Refs #31122

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:场景导出器旁边加了一个只读检查 `export-gallery --check DIR`,对 gallery 仓的一棵树逐条报问题:index.json 不合导出器自己的 schema、应用目录不完整或零截图、目录未登记、`framework.version` 不是已发布的稳定版 `@objectstack/cli`、出现 `.env*`/`node_modules`/符号链接/本机绝对路径。有问题就退出码 1。
- 为什么改:定时任务每个稳定版会往公开的 gallery 仓开一个 PR,你一键合并;这一键安全的前提是 PR 先被机器检查过。检查和导出器共用同一份 schema 和目录约定,两边不会漂移。
- 风险与回滚:只读,不写任何文件,不改导出器的行为(只把三个常量挪进共享模块,导出名不变);回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/qa/scenarios/src/export/check.ts`(各条规则与本机路径正则);`src/bin.ts` 与 `tsup.config.ts`(发布命令的懒加载入口);`test/export/check.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios test`,预期全绿;或对今天的 gallery 克隆跑 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios export-gallery --check "$(realpath ../gallery)"`,预期 `gallery check: clean`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

PR 1 of 2 for #31122. The gallery workflow (PR 2, objectstack-ai/gallery) runs this check on every PR there; it opens after this merges, pinned to this PR's merge commit.

- **`src/export/check.ts`** (new): `checkGallery(dir, { publishedVersions })` answers one finding per defect, each `CODE PATH: MESSAGE`. Codes: `index-json`, `app-missing`, `app-incomplete`, `app-screenshots`, `app-unlisted`, `framework-version`, `env-file`, `node-modules`, `symbolic-link`, `local-path`. Each finding carries its code as `kind`, a kebab-case diagnostic code and never an ADR-0112 wire code, so the error-code guards do not read it as one. It reads `GalleryIndexSchema` from `manifest.ts` and the app layout from `contract.ts`, the same ones the exporter writes with, so nothing is restated.
  - An absent `index.json` is an empty gallery, as the exporter and the refresh read it.
  - A complete `apps/ID/` holds `README.md`, `run-record.json`, `scorecard.json`/`.md`, `transcript.json`/`.md`, `source/objectstack.config.ts`, at least one screenshot (seat ruling Q3), every listed screenshot on disk and nothing unlisted in `screenshots/`.
  - `framework.version` must match `STABLE_VERSION` and be in `@objectstack/cli`'s published version list. **Offline (tests):** the list is handed in. **Online (CLI, workflow):** `npm view @objectstack/cli versions --json` (`npmPublishedVersions`), the same `npm view` channel the refresh already uses for `latest`. npm is asked only when the index lists an app, so an empty gallery needs no network.
  - The tree scan skips `.git` only. It flags a name starting `.env`, a `node_modules` directory (not walked), a symbolic link (not followed), and a text file naming a local absolute path (`LOCAL_PATH`: home, temp and mount roots, `file:///`, Windows user and system paths). A file with a NUL byte in its first 8 KiB (a PNG) is checked by name only.
- **`src/export/check-cli.ts`** (new): `mainCheck(argv)`. Exit 0 clean, 1 on any finding, 2 on a usage error. `--check DIR` takes no other flag.
- **`src/export/cli.ts`**: `export-gallery --check DIR` hands off to `mainCheck` before any card or run is loaded.
- **`src/bin.ts`, `tsup.config.ts`**: the published `objectstack-scenarios export-gallery --check DIR`. It loads the check from its own built entry, `dist/export-check.js`, the way `run` loads `dist/cli.js`, so `help` and `version` still load `dist/bin.js` alone. The export itself is not offered on the bin, since it reads a checkout's records and cards.
- **`src/export/contract.ts`** (new): `APP_LAYOUT`, `FRAMEWORK_PACKAGE` and `STABLE_VERSION` move here from `exporter.ts` and `refresh.ts`. Both re-export them, so `@objectstack/scenarios/export` exports the same names. The check imports this module and not the exporter's graph.
- **README**: a section "Checking a gallery PR — `export-gallery --check`". **Changeset**: `31122-scenarios-gallery-check.md`, `patch`.

**Reading on today's gallery** (objectstack-ai/gallery `main` 09ce9b06: six hand-written files, no `index.json`, no app directory): `gallery check: clean`, 0 findings, exit 0, through both doors (the checkout's `pnpm … export-gallery --check` and the built bin).

## Tests

- `test/export/check.test.ts` (new, 37 cases). The clean tree is the **exporter's own output** for the real crm fixture run, with a screenshot, plus the gallery's hand-written READMEs. A check that refused what the exporter writes fails there first. Each failing tree is that clean tree with one defect added, at least one case per code, all with an injected version list. The cases also cover today's empty gallery (npm never asked), the three CLI exit codes, the checkout door and the bin door.
- `test/build/packed-tarball.test.ts`: the bin pin now also expects `import("./export-check.js")` and `dist/export-check.js` in the tarball, and the static imports are still only `fs`, `path` and `url`. A new case runs the packed bin under plain Node on an empty gallery (exit 0) and on one with `.env` (exit 1). `built-consumer.test.ts` does not read the bin, so it is unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- **Deviation (seat ruling on step 1):** `objectstack-scenarios export-gallery` is a new bin command, which would read as widening on a released package. `@objectstack/scenarios` has never been published (`npm view` answers E404 on 2026-11-09), so no released surface widens, and the claim's `Clause-②: no` is kept.
- `symbolic-link` is one finding beyond the card's list. The content scan cannot see what a link points at, so an unflagged link would let anything through. The exporter already refuses to export one (`source.ts`).
- `local-path` is a closed list of local roots, not "any leading slash", so routes (`/api/v1/…`) and URL paths are not flagged. A path outside the list (for example `/usr/…`) is not caught.
- The gallery's branch protection (PR only, this check required) is a repository setting for the maintainer, not code here.

## Verification

Package suites on head `afee5f75`. The merge of main (head `03dbda01`) brought 3 commits, none in `packages/qa/scenarios`, so nothing was re-run. Head `bf29bcf0` fixes the CI red on `03dbda01` (`Dispatcher error-code vocabulary guard`: the scan read the finding helper's `{ code }` object literal as an error-code stamp and `symlink` as an unregistered code). The code is now `symbolic-link` and the field `kind`. On `bf29bcf0`: `pnpm check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary` OK, `pnpm check:error-code-casing` 0, package typecheck + 32 files / 654 tests passed, eslint 0.

<details><summary>Package: typecheck, 32 files / 654 tests, eslint</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios typecheck && pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios test` under the verify lock: VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 32 passed (32), Tests 654 passed (654).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios build` then `test/build/packed-tarball.test.ts` + `test/runner/library.test.ts`: 2 files, 17 tests passed.
- `npx eslint` on the ten touched source and test files: exit 0, no errors (`packed-tarball.test.ts` is in the ignore list).
- Built `dist/bin.js`: static imports `fs`, `path` and `url` only; lazy `import("./cli.js")` and `import("./export-check.js")`.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: the zero-screenshot rule</summary>

- `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `check.ts` replaced `if (app.screenshots.length === 0) add('app-screenshots'` with `if (false) …` (anchor 1 to 0, blob 71c32a9a to 19db493b). `check.test.ts`: 1 failed, 36 passed. The failure was the case "an entry with no screenshot fails".
- Restored: blob back to 71c32a9a, equal to HEAD; `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

<details><summary>Dispatch gates: 60 derived, 59 run, 1 NOT MEASURED</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 60 commands on `afee5f75`. 59 exited 0, `pnpm check:type-check-debt` among them (under the verify lock, 322 s).
- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: the workspace is not fully built). CI's run is the evidence.
- `dispatch-gates --ran` with each exit code: 60 accounted for, 59 run, 1 NOT MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- `--tier`: no path-derived mandate. Changed lines 719, under the 3,000 threshold.

</details>
